articles.title: Hiroshima Day — 6 August (Observance Begins); UN Calls for Nuclear Disarmament
articles.title_hi: हिरोशिमा दिवस — 6 अगस्त (स्मरण शुरू); UN ने Nuclear Disarmament का आह्वान किया
articles.summary: Ahead of Hiroshima Day (6 August), the UN Secretary-General renewed calls for nuclear disarmament, marking 81 years since the 1945 atomic bombing.
articles.summary_hi: Hiroshima Day (6 अगस्त) से पहले, UN Secretary-General ने nuclear disarmament के लिए आह्वान renewed किया, 1945 atomic bombing के 81 वर्षों को चिह्नित करते हुए।
articles.content:
Hiroshima Day is observed on 6 August every year to commemorate the atomic bombing of Hiroshima in 1945 during World War II. Nagasaki Day follows on 9 August. The bombings led to Japan's surrender and remain central to global debates on nuclear weapons.

In August 2026, the UN Secretary-General called for renewed nuclear disarmament efforts ahead of the 81st anniversary. The Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT) entered into force in 1970. India is not a signatory to the NPT but supports global disarmament in a time-bound framework.

For IB ACIO: Hiroshima Day — 6 August; Nagasaki Day — 9 August; NPT — 1970.
articles.content_hi:
Hiroshima Day: 6 August (1945 bombing)। Nagasaki Day: 9 August। NPT — 1970। India — NPT signatory नहीं।

IB ACIO: 6 Aug Hiroshima — याद रखें।

articles.question_hi: 1945 atomic bombing की स्मृति में Hiroshima Day प्रतिवर्ष कब मनाया जाता है?
articles.explanation: Hiroshima Day is observed on 6 August; Nagasaki Day is on 9 August.
articles.explanation_hi: Hiroshima Day 6 अगस्त को मनाया जाता है; Nagasaki Day 9 अगस्त को।

articles.moreInfo_hi: संबंधित: International Day against Nuclear Tests, 29 अगस्त।

articles.title: Government Launches 'Meri Mati Mera Desh 2.0' Ahead of Independence Day
articles.title_hi: सरकार ने स्वतंत्रता दिवस से पहले 'Meri Mati Mera Desh 2.0' शुरू किया
articles.summary: The Ministry of Culture launched 'Meri Mati Mera Desh 2.0' for 9–15 August 2026, combining Amrit Kalash yatras, tree plantation, and pledge ceremonies for the 80th Independence Day.
articles.summary_hi: संस्कृति मंत्रालय ने 9-15 अगस्त 2026 हेतु 'Meri Mati Mera Desh 2.0' शुरू किया, जिसमें Amrit Kalash yatras, वृक्षारोपण और 80वें स्वतंत्रता दिवस हेतु शपथ समारोह शामिल हैं।
articles.content:
In August 2026, the Ministry of Culture launched 'Meri Mati Mera Desh 2.0' for 9–15 August, ahead of the 80th Independence Day on 15 August 2026. The campaign includes Amrit Kalash yatras carrying soil from villages, tree plantation under 'Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam', and pledge ceremonies at panchayat level.

The original Meri Mati Mera Desh campaign was launched in 2023 under Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav. It complements the Har Ghar Tiranga campaign (13–15 August).

For IB ACIO: Meri Mati Mera Desh 2.0, Ministry of Culture, 9-15 Aug 2026, 80th Independence Day.
articles.content_hi:
Meri Mati Mera Desh 2.0: 9-15 Aug 2026, Ministry of Culture। Amrit Kalash, Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam। 80th Independence Day — 15 Aug 2026।

IB ACIO: Meri Mati Mera Desh — याद रखें।

articles.explanation: Meri Mati Mera Desh is a Ministry of Culture initiative under the Independence Day celebrations framework.

articles.title: Lok Sabha Passes Immigration and Foreigners Bill, 2026
articles.title_hi: लोकसभा ने Immigration and Foreigners Bill, 2026 पारित किया
articles.summary: The Lok Sabha passed the Immigration and Foreigners Bill, 2026, consolidating four colonial-era laws on entry, stay, and exit of foreigners in India.
articles.summary_hi: लोकसभा ने Immigration and Foreigners Bill, 2026 पारित किया, जो भारत में foreigners के entry, stay और exit से संबंधित चार colonial-era कानूनों को consolidate करता है।
articles.content:
In August 2026, the Lok Sabha passed the Immigration and Foreigners Bill, 2026, consolidating the Foreigners Act 1946, Passport (Entry into India) Act 1920, Registration of Foreigners Act 1939, and Immigration (Carriers' Liability) Act 2000 into a single modern statute.

The Bill strengthens powers for registration, visa overstays, and deportation while introducing digital immigration records. It is administered by the Ministry of Home Affairs through the Bureau of Immigration.

For IB ACIO: Immigration and Foreigners Bill 2026, MHA, consolidates 4 laws, Bureau of Immigration.
articles.content_hi:
Immigration and Foreigners Bill 2026: MHA। 4 laws consolidate — Foreigners Act 1946, Passport Entry Act 1920, Registration of Foreigners Act 1939, Carriers' Liability Act 2000।

IB ACIO: MHA immigration bill — याद रखें।

articles.question_hi: Immigration and Foreigners Bill, 2026 किसके द्वारा administered है?

articles.explanation_hi: Bill गृह मंत्रालय के अधीन है, Bureau of Immigration के माध्यम से implemented।

articles.title: Anita Anand of Canada Visits India; New High Commissioner Appointed
articles.title_hi: Canada की Anita Anand ने भारत का दौरा किया; नए High Commissioner नियुक्त
articles.summary: India appointed senior diplomat Ajay Bisaria as High Commissioner to Canada as bilateral ties stabilised after the 2023-24 diplomatic freeze.
articles.summary_hi: 2023-24 diplomatic freeze के बाद bilateral ties stabilise होने पर भारत ने senior diplomat Ajay Bisaria को Canada के High Commissioner के रूप में नियुक्त किया।
articles.content:
In August 2026, India appointed Ajay Bisaria, former High Commissioner to Pakistan and Secretary (West) in MEA, as High Commissioner to Canada. The appointment follows gradual normalisation of ties after the 2023 diplomatic row over Khalistani separatism allegations.

Bisaria previously served as India's envoy to Poland and Pakistan. High Commissioners represent Commonwealth countries in place of ambassadors.

For IB ACIO: Ajay Bisaria — HC to Canada, ex-HC Pakistan, Commonwealth uses High Commissioner.
articles.content_hi:
Ajay Bisaria: HC to Canada (Aug 2026), ex-HC Pakistan, ex-Secretary (West) MEA। Commonwealth — High Commissioner (not Ambassador)।

IB ACIO: Bisaria Canada — याद रखें।

articles.title: India's Aditya-L1 Completes First Full Solar Cycle Observation Report
articles.title_hi: भारत के Aditya-L1 ने First Full Solar Cycle Observation Report पूरी की
articles.summary: ISRO's Aditya-L1 solar observatory released its first annual science report, delivering continuous data on the Sun's corona, solar wind, and flare activity from the L1 Lagrange point.
articles.summary_hi: ISRO का Aditya-L1 solar observatory ने अपनी first annual science report जारी की, L1 Lagrange point से Sun के corona, solar wind और flare activity पर continuous data दिया।
articles.content:
In August 2026, ISRO's Aditya-L1 mission released its first full-year science report. Aditya-L1, launched on 2 September 2023 aboard PSLV-C57, orbits the Sun-Earth L1 Lagrange point, about 1.5 million km from Earth.

Payloads include VELC (Visible Emission Line Coronagraph), SUIT (Solar Ultraviolet Imaging Telescope), and plasma analysers. The mission supports space weather forecasting for satellite and power grid protection.

For IB ACIO: Aditya-L1, launch 2 Sep 2023, PSLV-C57, L1 point, ISRO solar mission.
articles.content_hi:
Aditya-L1: launch 2 Sep 2023, PSLV-C57, L1 Lagrange point (1.5 mn km)। Payloads — VELC, SUIT। Space weather forecasting।

IB ACIO: Aditya-L1 2023 — याद रखें।
articles.question: Aditya-L1, India's solar observatory, orbits which location?
articles.question_hi: Aditya-L1, भारत का solar observatory, किस location की orbit में है?
articles.explanation: Aditya-L1 is placed at the Sun-Earth L1 Lagrange point, about 1.5 million km from Earth.
articles.explanation_hi: Aditya-L1 Sun-Earth L1 Lagrange point पर स्थित है, पृथ्वी से लगभग 1.5 million km।

articles.title: India Becomes World's Third-Largest Economy by Nominal GDP: IMF Update
articles.title_hi: IMF Update: Nominal GDP में भारत विश्व की तीसरी सबसे बड़ी अर्थव्यवस्था बना
articles.summary: The IMF's August 2026 World Economic Outlook projected India as the world's third-largest economy by nominal GDP, surpassing Japan at current exchange rates.
articles.summary_hi: IMF के August 2026 World Economic Outlook ने India को current exchange rates पर Japan से आगे nominal GDP में विश्व की तीसरी सबसे बड़ी अर्थव्यवस्था projected किया।
articles.content:
In August 2026, the IMF's World Economic Outlook projected India as the third-largest economy by nominal GDP, after the United States and China, having surpassed Japan. India retained the fastest-growing major economy tag with projected growth near 6.5% for FY2026-27.

Key drivers include domestic consumption, services exports, and manufacturing under the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes. IMF HQ is in Washington, D.C.

For IB ACIO: IMF WEO Aug 2026, India 3rd largest nominal GDP, after US and China.
articles.content_hi:
IMF WEO (Aug 2026): India — 3rd largest economy (nominal GDP), after US, China। Growth ~6.5% FY2026-27। HQ — Washington DC।

IB ACIO: India 3rd economy — याद रखें।

articles.title: India Assumes Chairmanship of Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA)
articles.title_hi: भारत ने Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) की Chairmanship संभाली
articles.summary: India assumed the two-year chairmanship of IORA for 2026-28, prioritising maritime security, blue economy, and disaster risk reduction in the Indian Ocean region.
articles.summary_hi: भारत ने 2026-28 हेतु IORA की दो वर्ष की Chairmanship संभाली, Indian Ocean region में maritime security, blue economy और disaster risk reduction को प्राथमिकता दी।
articles.content:
In August 2026, India assumed the chairmanship of the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) for 2026-28. IORA has 23 member states and 11 dialogue partners, with Secretariat in Ebene, Mauritius.

India's priorities include maritime safety, trade facilitation, fisheries, and climate resilience. IORA was established in 1997 as the Indian Ocean Rim Association for Regional Cooperation (IOR-ARC), renamed IORA in 2010.

For IB ACIO: IORA chairmanship India 2026-28, HQ Mauritius, 23 members, est. 1997.
articles.content_hi:
IORA: India chair 2026-28। HQ — Ebene, Mauritius। 23 members। Established 1997 (as IOR-ARC), renamed 2010।

IB ACIO: IORA Mauritius — याद रखें।

articles.title: NCERT Releases Revised Textbooks under NCF 2023 for Classes 9-12
articles.title_hi: NCERT ने Classes 9-12 हेतु NCF 2023 के तहत Revised Textbooks जारी किए
articles.summary: NCERT released revised textbooks for Classes 9-12 aligned with the National Curriculum Framework (NCF) 2023, emphasising competency-based learning and Indian knowledge systems.
articles.summary_hi: NCERT ने National Curriculum Framework (NCF) 2023 के अनुरूप Classes 9-12 के revised textbooks जारी किए, competency-based learning और Indian knowledge systems पर जोर।
articles.content:
In August 2026, NCERT released revised textbooks for Classes 9-12 under the National Curriculum Framework (NCF) 2023. Changes include competency-based questions, integration of vocational education, and expanded coverage of Indian contributions to science and mathematics.

NCF 2023 was released by NCERT following the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. CBSE board exams will align question papers to the new framework from 2027.

For IB ACIO: NCF 2023, NEP 2020, NCERT, competency-based education.
articles.content_hi:
NCF 2023 → NCERT textbooks Classes 9-12 (Aug 2026)। NEP 2020 framework। Competency-based learning।

articles.title: BWF China Open 2026: Satwik-Chirag Reach Men's Doubles Final
articles.title_hi: BWF China Open 2026: Satwik-Chirag Men's Doubles Final में पहुंचे
articles.summary: India's Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty reached the men's doubles final at the BWF China Open 2026 Super 1000 tournament in Changzhou.
articles.summary_hi: India के Satwiksairaj Rankireddy और Chirag Shetty ने Changzhou में BWF China Open 2026 Super 1000 tournament के men's doubles final में प्रवेश किया।
articles.content:
In August 2026, India's top men's doubles pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty reached the final of the BWF China Open Super 1000 in Changzhou. The pair, former world No. 1, are India's leading badminton doubles combination.

Super 1000 is the highest BWF tournament tier below the World Championships and Olympics. India's badminton success follows Lakshya Sen and PV Sindhu's earlier Super Series titles.

For IB ACIO: Satwik-Chirag, men's doubles, BWF Super 1000, China Open 2026.
articles.content_hi:
Satwik-Chirag: men's doubles, BWF China Open Super 1000 (Aug 2026), Changzhou। Former world No. 1 pair।

IB ACIO: Satwik-Chirag — याद रखें।

articles.title: National Handloom Day Preparations — 7 August; Handloom Mark Promoted
articles.title_hi: राष्ट्रीय हथकरघा दिवस की तैयारी — 7 अगस्त; Handloom Mark को बढ़ावा
articles.summary: Ahead of National Handloom Day (7 August), the Ministry of Textiles promoted the Handloom Mark and GeM portal onboarding for handloom weavers under the 'My Handloom My Pride' campaign.
articles.summary_hi: National Handloom Day (7 अगस्त) से पहले, textiles मंत्रालय ने 'My Handloom My Pride' campaign के तहत Handloom Mark और GeM portal onboarding को बढ़ावा दिया।
articles.content:
National Handloom Day is observed on 7 August every year, commemorating the Swadeshi Movement launch on 7 August 1905. In August 2026, the Ministry of Textiles intensified the 'My Handloom My Pride' campaign ahead of the observance.

Initiatives include Handloom Mark certification for authenticity, GeM (Government e-Marketplace) onboarding for weaver cooperatives, and e-commerce linkages. India has over 3.5 million handloom workers, the largest such workforce globally.

For IB ACIO: National Handloom Day — 7 August, Swadeshi Movement 1905, Ministry of Textiles.
articles.content_hi:
National Handloom Day: 7 August (Swadeshi Movement, 7 Aug 1905)। Ministry of Textiles, Handloom Mark, GeM onboarding।

IB ACIO: 7 Aug Handloom Day — याद रखें।
